title: Answer: basic on the panpsychist form, built from protophenomenal properties on the other

statements.text: The family does not settle this. On Russellian panpsychism experience is a fundamental component of the universe. On Russellian panprotopsychism it is not, and is constituted by protophenomenal properties that are not themselves experiences.

sources.quote: On Russellian panpsychism consciousness is a fundamental component of the universe, whereas on Russellian panprotopsychism it is not.
